plugins.name: designcraft
plugins.description: Page layout, CSV data merge, InDesign IDML, and print-ready PDF/X-4, PNG, EPUB, and HTML using your local DesignCraft engine.

plugins.name: effectcraft
plugins.description: Create motion graphics, animated titles, templates, keyframes, expressions, and VFX; render MP4, ProRes, WebM, GIF, and Lottie.

plugins.name: lightcraft
plugins.description: Develop RAW photos and batches with auto tone, 125 sliders, presets, local masks, HDR/panorama DNG merges, and sharpness culling.

plugins.name: photocraft
plugins.description: Edit photos and layered designs: resize, crop, Camera Raw, 123 filters, background removal, text, and PSD/PNG/JPEG/WebP conversion.

plugins.name: vectorcraft
plugins.description: Vectorize bitmaps with Image Trace, compose vector art and charts, recolor, and convert across 20 formats (SVG, PDF, AI, EPS, DXF).

plugins.name: pdfcraft
plugins.description: Merge, split, OCR, watermark, redact, fill forms, digitally sign, encrypt, compress, and convert PDFs to Word, HTML, images, and PDF/A.

plugins.name: filmcraft
plugins.description: Split, trim, color-grade with Lumetri looks, apply 131 video effects, join clips with transitions, and export MP4, ProRes, GIF, and FCPXML.

plugins.name: wordcraft
plugins.description: Author, edit with tracked changes and comments, mail-merge, and convert documents across DOCX, PDF, ODT, RTF, HTML, Markdown, and LaTeX.

plugins.name: soundcraft
plugins.description: Compose multitrack audio and MIDI synth/drum sessions, mix with 30 built-in plugins, measure LUFS loudness, and export WAV, FLAC, stems, and MIDI.

plugins.name: deckcraft
plugins.description: Create, edit, inspect, and convert PowerPoint (.pptx) decks with themes, bullets, charts, tables, speaker notes, PDF handouts, and PNG slides.

plugins.name: gridcraft
plugins.description: Build, edit, evaluate live formulas (515 Excel functions), chart, PivotTable, and convert spreadsheets across XLSX, CSV, ODS, JSON, HTML, and PDF.
